description: A full-scale GPS was tested in the Mark I Space Chamber at AEDC in 1977. The tests checked reliability of the satellite's systems prior to its launch in 1978. AEDC personnel reflected back on this testing on July 17, 2015, the 20th anniversary of when GPS reached full-operational capability.
